reason: PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_2^*(2460)- pi+ , D^*_2()- --> D0 pi-'. A D_2*(2460)- (anti-c d) decays strongly to Dbar0 pi-; D0 pi- would change charm by two units. The listing means Dbar0 pi-, as it writes for S042.320 and S042.419.
PDG text: 'B0 --> Dbar_0^*(2400)- pi+ , D^*_0()- --> D0 pi-'. Same misprint as S042.124: a D_0*- decays to Dbar0 pi-, as the listing writes for S042.554 and S042.418.
PDG text: 'B0 --> D_sJ(2457)+ D^*(2010) , D_sJ()+ --> D_s()+ gamma', without the charge of the D*. Charge conservation in a B0 decay with a D_sJ+ fixes it to D*(2010)-.

PDG text: 'B0 --> D+- D^*()-+ (CP-averaged)' (6.14e-4): the sum of the two charge states D*+ D- and D*- D+, which the decay file lists as two lines of 3.05e-4. Confirmed with the source, Belle arXiv:1203.6647: B(B0 -> D*+- D-+) = (6.14 +- 0.29 +- 0.50)e-4 from one yield of both charge states.

PDG text: 'B0 --> D^*(2010)+ D-' = 6.12e-4, equal to S042.511 'D+- D^*()-+ (CP-averaged)' = 6.14e-4; read as the same charge sum, it would give the D*+ D- line c = 2 and leave D*- D+ without a node. Its own sources were not checked; S042.511 (confirmed to be the sum, 2.6 times more precise) fixes both lines, so this entry is not needed.

PDG text: 'B+ --> psi(2S) K_1(1270)+ , K_1(1270)+ --> K+ pi+ pi-' (3.30e-5) is listed next to '[ same ](P-wave)' S041.859 (3.26e-5) and '[ same ](D-wave)' S041.860 (2.96e-5), whose sum exceeds it: one component of the psi(2S) K+ pi+ pi- amplitude fit, not the total rate.

D1 (2026-11-17). PDG text: 'B0 --> D- a_1(1260)+' = (0.60 +- 0.33) %, an old measurement with 54 % error. The decay-file line D- a_1+ (line 697, 1.071 %) carries the comment 'Interpreting D3pi BF as fully (D- a1(->3pi)) decay': its BF is the D- pi+ pi+ pi- total divided by B(a_1+ --> pi+ pi+ pi-). The total S042.88 (0.598 +- 0.061 %) is the measurement the line was built from and is five times more precise, so the line is compared with it (direct_line entry) and this entry is not used.

D1 (2026-11-17). PDG text: 'B0 --> D- pi+ pi+ pi-' = (0.598 +- 0.061) %. The decay file has no direct D- pi+ pi+ pi- line: it routes the whole final state through D- a_1+ (line 697, comment 'Interpreting D3pi BF as fully (D- a1(->3pi)) decay'). The line therefore stands for this inclusive final state and takes its c from the total, after the other lines that feed it.

D2 (2026-11-17). The c of 'D- D_s0*+' comes from PDG products with D_s0*(2317)+ --> D_s+ pi0. If the sub-decay is below 100 %, the B rate and c are larger by up to 25 %; 20 % is added in quadrature to sigma_c.

2026-11-17. B0 --> psi(3770) K0 (lines 592-594: K0 with BF 0, K_S0, K_L0) has only product upper limits in PDG (S042.393, S042.394), and the decay file is above them. The isospin partner B+ --> psi(3770) K+ is measured (S041.360). b --> c cbar s decays conserve isospin, so the B0 lines take the B+ value divided by the lifetime ratio.

G3 (2026-11-18). PDG text: 'B+ --> Dbar_1^*(2420)0 rho+' < 1.4e-3 (S041.215, CLEO). The decay file (line 4319) has 3.72e-3, set as twice B+ --> anti-D_10 pi+ (the D**rho = 2 x D**pi assumption of BELLE2-NOTE-PH-2022-002), 2.7 times the limit. The line takes c = limit/2 +- limit/2, i.e. 0.19 +- 0.19.

P1 option (c), 2026-11-18. PDG text: 'B+ --> psi(3770) K+' (S041.360, 4.34e-4) times B(psi(3770) --> D+ D-) = 0.41 is 81 % of 'B+ --> D- D+ K+' (S041.336, 2.2e-4). The LHCb amplitude analysis (arXiv:2009.00026, Table 4) measures a psi(3770) fit fraction of 14.5 +- 1.4 % in B+ --> D+ D- K+, i.e. c = 0.16 for this line with the PDG total. The two measurements conflict; it is not known which is wrong. The PDG central value is kept and 80 % is added in quadrature to sigma_c (0.23 --> 0.75), so that the LHCb-based value lies within 1 sigma.
